title: Reference solution: Fit and evaluate a polynomial
answer:
import numpy as np

x = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0])
y = np.array([1.0, 3.0, 5.0, 7.0])
p = np.polynomial.Polynomial.fit(x, y, deg=1)
print(p(x).round(2))
